messages:
marta: Heads-up: customer ACME opened ticket 78912 — sudden spike in 502/504s around 02:45 UTC. They report ‘SSL handshake timeout’ and intermittent 5xx when calling hosted API.
alex: grabbing traces now. Is the issue multi-region or concentrated? ACME says mostly eu but also some us-east retries.
priya: I can see a cert rotation started at 02:40 UTC for eu-edge pool. Rotation claimed success, but some backends still returning old cert chain per probe.
ingrid-oncall: found resolver inconsistency during that window. Different public recursors returned different A records for api-hosted.redwood.ai which maps to host pools with different cert versions. That’s a likely SNI/pool mismatch causing handshake errors.
alex: please paste your repro commands.
ingrid-oncall: here's quick repro I used:
```
$ dig +short @1.1.1.1 api-hosted.redwood.ai A
34.210.112.7
$ dig +short @8.8.8.8 api-hosted.redwood.ai A
34.210.200.9
$ curl -v --resolve "api-hosted.redwood.ai:443:34.210.200.9" https://api-hosted.redwood.ai/health
* Connected to 34.210.200.9 (34.210.200.9) port 443 (#0)
* TLS 1.3 handshake completed
> GET /health HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 502
{"error":"upstream handshake failure: certificate chain mismatch"}
```
marta: also seeing egress NAT churn in metrics — ephemeral port exhaustion on a subset of egress nodes during rotation window. That caused retries to land on different IPs and made the problem worse.
priya: timeline summary: 02:40 start cert push -> 02:42 small resolver TTL flaps observed -> 02:45 client reports 502/504 spike -> 02:58 last retry spike. Correlation between resolver variability + NAT port churn.
alex: short-term mitigations for support to tell customer: 1) exponential backoff/retry for a few minutes, 2) we pinned their tenant to eu-west-2 for 30m, 3) infra paused further batches. Also posted a note to ticket 78912.
ingrid-oncall: filing infra escalation INF-3421. Attached tcpdump: lots of SYN/SYN-ACK then immediate RSTs from hosts that still served old certs. Looks like hosts were drained in an order that exposed clients to mixed certs.
priya: repro checklist for SRE/infra:
- query multiple public resolvers (1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8, regional recursors) and compare A sets
- curl --resolve to each IP and inspect certificate subject/chain
- check egress ephemeral port usage and tcp_retransmit metrics during rollout
- review host drain order in cert rollout playbook
marta: infra action items: pause rotation batches, stabilize DNS TTLs, add rollout gating on resolver A-set consistency, and increase egress ephemeral port headroom temporarily.
alex: longer-term follow-ups: audit rotation drain order, add resolver-consistency check to rollout automation, add alarms for NAT ephemeral port pressure, and add canary probes that validate cert chain across common public recursors.
priya: monitoring note — well watch for 1 hour and reopen escalation if 5xx rate doesn't return to baseline. Last observed spike ended ~02:58 UTC.
marta: thanks. Please append notes to support ticket 78912 and INF-3421 and assign any infra TODOs to oncall.
